sloka: काष्ठयोः स्वेन रूपेण जनयामास पावकम् ।दीप्यमानम् ततो वह्निम् पुष्पैः अभ्यर्च्य सत्कृतम् ॥४-५-१४॥
transliteration: kāṣṭhayoḥ svena rūpeṇa janayāmāsa pāvakam ।dīpyamānam tato vahnim puṣpaiḥ abhyarcya satkṛtam ॥4-5-14॥

translations.english: Then, Hanuman vanquisher of enemies, gave up his guise of a mendicant, assumed his natural form and generated fire by rubbing two pieces of wood. Wellpleased at heart, he made an offering of flowers to the flaming fire and placed it between them.
translations.hindi: मैं केवल मित्रता के कर्तब्य से प्रेरित हा, आपसे आपके हित की बात कहता हूँ--मैं आपको उपदेश नहीं देता । अतः आप मेरी मैत्री को मान. शोक मत कीजिए
